contact.name: Sales Staff
contact.evidence_quote: Our normal sales office hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday through Friday, we are closed on Saturdays and Sundays. Please call us during these hours and our sales staff will be happy to answer any questions you may have. If lines are busy or a salesperson is not available, you will be forwarded to our voice mail system. You may leave your name & phone number & the next available salesperson will return your call shortly.

contacts.rung: Secretary / administration (last resort). The sales staff are responsible for answering customer questions and inquiries.
